verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships Visalaw AI, which claims it can "automate entire workflows" and includes a "Research Agent". That gives only glancing support for agentic automation. The example prompts all describe interactive, on-demand tasks, and nothing shows automations being configured to run unattended in the background. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled, triggered or background runs, an automation setup or configuration surface, autonomous operation without a user prompt, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
